description: This file defines the API routes for task management within a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, toggling, and deleting tasks, with all operations scoped to the authenticated user. It utilizes dependency injection, data validation models, and a service layer for business logic.

classes.name: TaskResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for serializing task data in API responses.

methods.name: list_tasks( skip: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of items to skip."), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100, description="Maximum number of items to return."), user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), task_service: TaskService = Depends(TaskService), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list tasks for the current user with pagination.

methods.name: get_task( task_id: int, user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), task_service: TaskService = Depends(TaskService), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific task by ID for the current user.

methods.name: create_task( payload: TaskCreateRequest, user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), task_service: TaskService = Depends(TaskService), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new task for the current user.

methods.name: update_task( task_id: int, payload: TaskUpdateRequest, user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), task_service: TaskService = Depends(TaskService), )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to fully update an existing task.

methods.name: toggle_task( task_id: int, payload: TaskToggleRequest | None = None, user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), task_service: TaskService = Depends(TaskService), )
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to toggle or explicitly set the completion status of a task.

methods.name: delete_task( task_id: int, user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), task_service: TaskService = Depends(TaskService), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a task.
